description: Spellings that were once published and have since been retired. A retired spelling is never reassigned to a different concept: learners, lessons, docs and cached translations may still carry the old meaning, so reuse creates two meanings for one sound. Retirement used to be recorded as a hardcoded map in tools/fonoran-english-resolve.js, which is how `fa` was retired from `one` and then reassigned to `child`. This seed is the single source: the resolver reads it for backwards compatibility, root generation reserves every form here so the pool can never hand it out again, and scripts/fonoran-verify-invariants.js fails when a retired form reappears.

retired.reason: English near-profanity /fʌ/. Retired twice: first from `one` (which moved to `lu`), then reassigned to `child` on 2026-07-12 because retirement was recorded in code rather than here. `child` is now `da`. Resolves to `child` because that is the meaning in current caches.
